figures.alt: White louvered attic gable vent beneath a Florida roof peak
figures.caption: A gable vent sits high in the roofline, where wind, rain, and pests can enter. Inspect the louver, trim, and surrounding wall before ordering a replacement.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Attic ventilation equipment framed above insulation and a service walkway
figures.caption: Ventilation works as a system. The replacement vent, attic airflow, intake path, and roof assembly should be considered together instead of as isolated parts.

figures.alt: Raised attic platform preserving insulation depth and a clear airflow path
figures.caption: A damaged opening, widespread trim rot, or a combined ridge, soffit, and gable ventilation problem is a reason to evaluate the whole roof edge.
